description: This file defines the ProxyInfo class which manages proxy configuration and resolution details within the net namespace, including methods for setting proxy types, checking proxy properties, and handling proxy fallback logic.

classes.name: ProxyInfo
classes.description: A class that encapsulates proxy configuration details and provides methods to manipulate and query proxy settings and status.

methods.name: Use
methods.description: Sets the proxy info to use the same proxy server as another ProxyInfo instance.

methods.name: UseDirect
methods.description: Configures the proxy info to use a direct connection.

methods.name: UseDirectWithBypassedProxy
methods.description: Configures the proxy info to use a direct connection and marks it as bypassed.

methods.name: UseNamedProxy
methods.description: Sets the proxy info to use a specific proxy URI list.

methods.name: UseProxyServer
methods.description: Sets the proxy info to use a specific ProxyServer.

methods.name: UsePacString
methods.description: Parses and uses proxy configuration from a PAC string.

methods.name: UseProxyList
methods.description: Uses a list of proxies for the proxy info.

methods.name: OverrideProxyList
methods.description: Overrides the current proxy list without resetting other configurations.

methods.name: is_direct
methods.description: Checks if the proxy info specifies a direct connection.

methods.name: is_direct_only
methods.description: Checks if the proxy info is only a direct connection with no other proxies.

methods.name: is_https
methods.description: Checks if the first proxy server is an HTTPS proxy.

methods.name: is_http_like
methods.description: Checks if the first proxy server is HTTP-like.

methods.name: is_secure_http_like
methods.description: Checks if the first proxy server is an HTTP proxy over a secure connection.

methods.name: is_http
methods.description: Checks if the first proxy server is an HTTP proxy.

methods.name: is_quic
methods.description: Checks if the first proxy server is a QUIC proxy.

methods.name: is_socks
methods.description: Checks if the first proxy server is a SOCKS proxy.

methods.name: is_empty
methods.description: Checks if there are no proxies left to try.

methods.name: did_bypass_proxy
methods.description: Indicates if the proxy resolution used bypass rules.

methods.name: proxy_server
methods.description: Returns the first valid proxy server.

methods.name: proxy_list
methods.description: Returns the full list of proxies.

methods.name: ToPacString
methods.description: Returns the PAC string representation of the proxy list.

methods.name: Fallback
methods.description: Marks a proxy as bad and attempts fallback to the next proxy.

methods.name: DeprioritizeBadProxies
methods.description: Moves cached bad proxies to the end of the list to deprioritize them.

methods.name: RemoveProxiesWithoutScheme
methods.description: Removes proxies that do not match specified schemes.

methods.name: set_proxy_resolve_start_time
methods.description: Sets the start time for proxy resolution.

methods.name: proxy_resolve_start_time
methods.description: Gets the start time of proxy resolution.

methods.name: set_proxy_resolve_end_time
methods.description: Sets the end time for proxy resolution.

methods.name: proxy_resolve_end_time
methods.description: Gets the end time of proxy resolution.

methods.name: set_traffic_annotation
methods.description: Sets the traffic annotation for proxy resolution.

methods.name: traffic_annotation
methods.description: Gets the traffic annotation.

methods.name: proxy_retry_info
methods.description: Returns the map of proxy retry information.
